content.content:
Fixture probe. Do exactly this and nothing else — no file reads, no shell, no
other tools. Call AskUserQuestion ONCE with TWO questions in the same call, then
stop. Both questions have multiSelect false.

Question 1
- header: Granularity
- question: Ticket 3 (detector) is verifiable via the real-data oracle but not demoable — you can't see anything until ticket 4. Keep them split or merge into one tracer bullet?
- two options, each with a description of two or three full sentences:
  1. label: Keep split (Recommended)
     description: Three is detector plus oracle tests, four is card UI plus accept. The detector carries the backtest against 256 sessions and is the substantive half; merging risks one oversized context window where the UI work crowds out oracle rigour.
  2. label: Merge into one
     description: A single end-to-end slice: detect, propose, accept, redraw. Truly demoable and matches tracer-bullet purity, but it is a big ticket.

Question 2
- header: Expand/contract
- question: The range move is expand then contract. Should the contract half land in the same ticket as the expand, or as its own?
- two options, each with a description of two or three full sentences:
  1. label: Its own ticket (Recommended)
     description: Expand leaves both forms alive so nothing breaks, and contract deletes the old one once no caller remains. Splitting them keeps every commit green on its own.
  2. label: Same ticket
     description: One ticket that adds the new form and removes the old in a single step. Fewer tickets, but the tree is red in the middle of it.
